lines.en: I inch along, slow and steady.
The mulberry leaves rustle under me.
So many legs moving together.
I raise my head to find the next leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘被我咬出缺口。
lines.en: I bite a notch out of the leaf's edge.
I eat all day and all night.
I crawl over the veins, very slow.
From this leaf to that one.
The leaves behind me are bare.
I stay on the leaf's underside, cooler.
I move myself to the center of the leaf.
A little eating, a little walking.
I lie still and chew slowly.
The leaf shrinks in my mouth.
I tuck my head under the leaf.
I've eaten this far. Time for a rest.
I rest on a leaf vein.
Light moves across my back.

lines.zh: 我吐出一根丝，绕住叶柄。
lines.en: I spin a thread and wrap it around the leaf stem.
Quiet is good.
I breathe slowly.
This leaf isn't finished yet.
I curl myself a little.
I'll eat again in a bit.
I rest my head on the leaf edge.
I feel a little sticky.
Are you going to touch me?
I'm very soft.
Your fingers are much bigger than me.
Don't lift me off the leaf.
I really will die.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，桑叶还在嘴边。
lines.en: I lift my head at you, mulberry leaf still at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还咬着半片桑叶。
lines.en: Half a mulberry leaf is still in my mouth.
I'm eating. Don't interrupt.
There's room on the leaf.
Where you stepped, the leaf is crushed.
Don't pinch me with your fingers.
You've blocked the light above me.
I got squeezed.
It hurts. I curl into a ball.
My silk is spent; I curl into a ring.
Don't press down on me.
The silk is spent, I cannot move.
That was too much.
A few scales fell off.
I don't want to move anymore.
I slowly shrink back.
Don't do that again.
Is this a mulberry leaf?
Put it down where I can reach.
I only eat leaves.
That smell is very fresh.
That leaf in your hand, give it to me.
I'm hungry. I eat constantly.
Don't take it away. I've only had one bite.
This one is better than mine.
Come a little closer.
I'm crawling over slowly.
You touched me.
I fell off the leaf.
Don't crush me. I'll burst.
I rolled once and stopped.
Your hands are too rough.
I cling to the leaf surface.
One touch and I shrivel.
I dropped onto another leaf.
I nearly fell to the ground.
I crawl slowly back to the vein.
There's another under the leaf.
We lie side by side.
Don't watch. We're very quiet.
We're very close together.
In some days there'll be many eggs.
I've spun a little silk.
There are enough leaves for us.
She's a little whiter than me.
We're not noisy at all.
At night the leaves will rustle.
I drag this leaf along.
I bite down on the stem.
Too heavy. I can't drag it.
A leaf fragment you dropped?
I pull it over myself.
Is this thread mine?
I've wrapped once around it.
I slowly push it onto the leaf.
It's harder than a leaf.
I carry it in my mouth.
The leaves over there are tenderer.
I smell leaves.
I inch along the vein.
There are fresh mulberry leaves there.
I lift my head to look.
It's only a short stretch.
Don't block me in the middle.
I'm crawling to the leaf edge.
The leaf under me is moving.

lines.zh: 桑叶边缘被谁碰得发抖。
lines.en: Something nudged the mulberry leaf edge; it trembles.
That leaf over there is softer.
I stretch my head that way.
You're walking very close to me.
I know that leaf vein.
I crawl over bit by bit.
A little farther and I'm there.
The leaf edge is just ahead.
I stop to catch my breath.
So many legs, yet so slow.
This is the shortest way across.
I go around the vein.
There's a notch ahead.
I smell it. This leaf.
Just a little farther.
This leaf's edge is curling.
I can tell which leaves are tenderest.
I go along the leaf's edge.
Dew is blocking my way.
I go around, then back this way.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，牙太小。
lines.en: I bite your cuff; my teeth are far too small.
My teeth are tiny.
It's soft when I bite.

lines.zh: 桑叶的一角，够我啃很久。
lines.en: One corner of a mulberry leaf lasts me ages.

lines.zh: 我这么多脚，也只推得动一片叶。
lines.en: All these feet, and I can only push a leaf.
I was bounced back.
I twisted my body.
I spat a bit of silk.
This is a pitiful amount of force.
I slowly back away.
I wrapped a coil of silk.
I press my body onto your hand.
I twisted my body.
I butt your finger with my head.
I hatch out of the egg.
First thing, find a leaf.
I'm still damp.
This green is lovely.
I start eating at once.
The silk I spin can weave a whole bolt.
I crawl onto the leaf's underside.
The wind blows, and I hold tight.
This will house me for a while.
I've arrived, very quietly.
I take my first bite of leaf.
Water beads still cling to the vein.
I curl up on the leaf tip.
This leaf will feed me a day.
I poke out from the leaf's underside.
Two points, and all I do is spin.

lines.zh: 叶子先烧起来，然后是火。
lines.en: The leaf caught fire first, then me.

lines.zh: 两点血，一片叶子就是我的床。
lines.en: Two hit points, and one leaf is my bed.
Too much dew. I'm drowning.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和我一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flipped the leaf and me.
A small thorn went in.

lines.zh: 一道光打在我身上，我僵了。
lines.en: A flash hit me and I went stiff.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我饿得发干。
lines.en: The leaf is gone. I'm drying up with hunger.
Thunder shook the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，什么都抓不到。
lines.en: I'm falling with nothing to hold.
